title: Webhook Receiver Design Plan
description: A structured plan for an inbound webhook receiver -- signature, idempotency, latency, dead-letter, and reconciliation decisions -- so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/webhook_receiver_design_audit.mjs.

verifiesSignature.description: True if the provider's HMAC signature is verified before any processing.

signatureOverRawBody.description: True if the HMAC is computed over the raw wire bytes, not a parsed-then-restringified body.

timingSafeCompare.description: True if signature comparison uses crypto.timingSafeEqual, not ===.

replayWindowSeconds.description: Tolerance on the signed timestamp; events older than this are rejected (~300s recommended).

idempotencyPrimitive.description: The dedup mechanism keyed on the provider's event ID. db-unique-constraint is the correct answer.

processingModel.description: Whether the handler does the work inline or acks fast and enqueues for a worker.

ackLatencyBudgetMs.description: The p99 budget for returning 200 to the provider.

deadLetterAfterRetries.description: Number of worker attempts before an event is dead-lettered. 0 means no dead-letter.

replayToolingExists.description: True if a UI or CLI can list dead-lettered events and replay by ID or timestamp range.

stateSource.description: Where derived state comes from when processing an event. provider-api handles out-of-order delivery.

perEnvironmentSecrets.description: True if each endpoint/environment has its own webhook secret and CI fails when they match.

replayTestInCI.description: True if CI replays a captured event set twice and asserts identical DB state (idempotency proof).
